Legal Eviction Process in Ghana E-Book

Plain-language guide to the complete legal eviction process under Ghana's Rent Act, 1963 (Act 220). 12 comprehensive chapters covering everything from notice procedures to Rent Magistrate appearance.

What's Included

  • 12 Comprehensive Chapters: Complete coverage of the legal eviction process
  • HTML E-Book: Interactive version with print-to-PDF button (28KB)
  • PDF E-Book: Professional PDF version for offline reading
  • Print-Friendly Design: Optimized for printing or saving as PDF
  • WhatsApp Cards: 5 marketing cards with key chapter summaries
  • Legal Accuracy: All information verified against Act 220, L.I. 369, and Rent Court procedures
  • Practical Examples: Real-world scenarios and case studies from Accra Rent Court
  • Form Templates: Fillable Form 9 and supporting documents
  • Timestamped & Indexed: Easy navigation and quick reference

Chapter Overview

Chapters 1-4: Legal Foundations

  • Introduction to Act 220 and eviction grounds
  • Tenant rights and protections
  • Landlord rights and procedures
  • Pre-eviction compliance checklist

Chapters 5-8: The Notice Process

  • Serving notice (Form 9) requirements
  • Notice periods and extensions
  • Tenant response procedures
  • Proof of service documentation

Chapters 9-12: Rent Court Process

  • Filing application at Rent Court
  • Attending hearing and presenting evidence
  • Magistrate's decision and appeal options
  • Post-eviction: Execution and possession

Why This Guide?

Eviction is complex in Ghana. Many landlords don't follow proper procedures and lose their cases. This guide walks you through every step of the legal process under Act 220, with practical examples and templates. Avoid costly mistakes and protect your property rights.

Perfect For:

  • Landlords: Understand your legal rights and procedures before pursuing eviction
  • Property Managers: Reference guide for managing difficult tenant situations
  • Real Estate Agents: Educate clients on proper eviction procedures
  • Rent Officers: Background on Act 220 enforcement mechanisms
  • Legal Professionals: Quick reference for Rent Act provisions and procedures
